value.text: Largest region, with revenue from stores and digital channels across the U.S., Canada and related Americas markets.
Smaller but strategic international region, with APAC revenue separately tracked in ANF segment schedules.
International growth region served through stores and digital channels, with brand expansion and local market execution.
Abercrombie & Fitch Co. is a global, digitally led omnichannel specialty apparel retailer operating the Abercrombie and Hollister brand families across stores and digital channels.
• Comparable sales and traffic across Abercrombie and Hollister brand families.
• Gross margin execution, including product cost, freight, markdowns and tariff mitigation.
• International growth in EMEA and APAC.
• Inventory discipline and store/digital omnichannel execution.

The core advantage is the combination of two refreshed global brand families, an omnichannel store and digital model, disciplined inventory/markdown management, and balance-sheet flexibility for reinvestment and buybacks.
• Buybacks and liquidity supported by cash generation and no core conventional debt in the latest balance sheet.

ANF's current model is driven by brand momentum across Abercrombie and Hollister, comparable sales, gross margin discipline, inventory control, store optimization, digital/omnichannel engagement, international growth in EMEA/APAC, and capital returns supported by a net-cash balance sheet. Digital represented about 44% of 2025 year sales, supported by more than 1 billion platform visits.
• Demand or retention weakens faster than expected
